content:
[H] high | top-left header | "Custom Objects" title sits flush against the window edge with zero padding, and the subtitle "2 types · 2 objects · 1 link" is tiny, low-contrast metadata crammed directly beneath it.
[L] high | bottom edge | the "New object" form is cut off mid-field ("sku:" input clipped at window bottom), showing content truncated by the viewport with no scroll affordance visible.
[S] high | left sidebar | Edit/Delete button pairs for "Rmas (0)" and "Warranty Claims (2)" have inconsistent horizontal spacing and are not aligned to a shared left grid; the second row's buttons nearly touch the selected pill.
[S] high | right panel cards | Edit/Delete buttons sit at different x-positions on "Loose panel" vs "Broken hinge" cards because they trail the title text instead of right-aligning to the card edge.
[S] med | right panel forms | the "Link" button is right-aligned while the dropdown/inputs in the same row are left-aligned, leaving an uneven ragged row with inconsistent gaps.
[C] high | left half of screen | a huge empty dead zone (~450px wide) under the two type rows, while the right column is dense and scrolls off-screen — badly unbalanced composition.
[H] med | right cards | field labels (in_stock, qty, sku) in gray lowercase and values in bold mono are widely spaced with no clear pairing structure; each row floats at arbitrary vertical rhythm with large uneven gaps.
[H] med | right cards | raw field names like "in_stock:" and "sku:" rendered as debug-style snake_case keys at equal weight with no section grouping — reads as a data dump, not a product UI.
[C] med | object cards | Edit/Delete destructive actions are permanently visible on every card at full red saturation, creating visual noise instead of appearing on hover or in a menu.
[S] med | right column | gap between "Broken hinge" card and "New object" card is visibly larger than the gap between the first two cards — inconsistent card rhythm.
[H] low | header | "Warranty Claims objects" heading and the small "2" count badge sit at mismatched baseline weights with awkward spacing.
[C] low | search row | search input is ~200px wide while a lone "Search" button floats at the far right edge with a huge gap — orphaned control pair.
[L] low | sidebar | description text "Warranty claim records linked from conversations" starts flush at x=8 with no inset, colliding with the window margin used elsewhere.
[H] low | buttons | three competing emphasized styles on one screen (black pill, red buttons, outlined inputs) with no clear primary/secondary system.

VERDICT: unprofessional — a half-finished debug panel with raw field dumps, giant dead space, clipped content, and no consistent spacing or action system.
